text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Early on in the new year, Admire Vega and I are shopping for necessities when…

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text: Here you are, one bonus raffle ticket! Thanks for shopping with us!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …A raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!
choice_data_list: This must be part of that sale event going on.
This must be part of that sale event going on.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two! You have a ticket! Why not try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You could win a trip to a hot spring with incredible scenery out in the countryside! The starry sky will be sure to help you relax!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: (It looks like that might have piqued her interest.)
(It looks like that might have piqued her interest.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case…
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a ticket already. It would be a shame to let it go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's true… It would be a waste.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right, ready to give it a try? How about you do it together? Spin the tumbler with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right, ready to give it a try? How about you do it together? Spin the tumbler with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heart?
choice_data_list: Let's get that grand prize, Ayabe!
Let's get that grand prize, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait. What does he mean by heart?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ayabe and I spin the lottery machine with extra oomph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What? The grand prize? Seriously?
choice_data_list: You did it, Ayabe!
You did it, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe Admire Vega's in shock? She stares at the coupon for some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she finally starts to speak…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Here… Can you hold on to it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I don't really know what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do I really want to go? Or am I just… I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But it's not like seeing a special starry sky doesn't interest me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If it gets too close to the expiration date, you can use it however you like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So—
choice_data_list: I'll hold on to it for you.
I'll hold on to it for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: I'll wait for you to make your decision.
I'll wait for you to make your decision.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how I end up with the coupon for a hot spring vacation until Admire Vega makes up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: First prize…
choice_data_list: So close!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …It's still pretty lucky.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It feels heavy… I bet it's filling and tastes great.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Should we have it tonight?
choice_data_list: What? You're including me?
What? You're including me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why wouldn't I?
choice_data_list: That was your raffle ticket, so it should be yours.
That was your raffle ticket, so it should be yours.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's true, but…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't normally eat expensive things like this.
choice_data_list: All the more reason to celebrate your lucky pull!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before heading back, we pick out some things in the shopping district.
choice_data_list: First up, some scrumptious hors d'oeuvres.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Are you going to act like this the rest of the day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enjoy a full-course meal with the hamburger steak as the main dish.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Carrots… A lot of them…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't even think we could finish them all ourselves…
choice_data_list: Want to share them with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Everyone?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm! This grated carrot salad sandwich is fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's seasoned so well and super light! I feel like I could eat a whole bunch without getting full!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Would that be okay, though?! I feel like I've already had a lot!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I'm serving them because I want them all to be eaten. You can have as many as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I also owe you for those rice balls…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then I won't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe, be careful you don't choke…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Ayabe. I'll have some too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This would go great with… coffee. I think I'll have one too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Being able to eat with one hand certainly is more efficient… the nutritional balance of the ingredients is also on point.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Indeed, I should have no problem recruiting someone to feed me while I'm in the middle of my experiments!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Use your own hands, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wow! They're so colorful! Can I have one to eat while I'm reading?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Haha! It's like we've been drawn here by fate! ☆ Brought together by these marvelous sandwiches! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think we invited too many people…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega's voice drips with regret, but looking at her face, she doesn't really seem to mind.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A single carrot…
choice_data_list: I'm sorry it's not the grand prize.
I'm sorry it's not the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's not very easy to get. I suppose this is better than nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine… It's a decent prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the raffle…

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Sob… I'm sorry, Sis…

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: You don't have to cry! I forgot too, Aiko!

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: But we can't make curry without a carrot… What will Mom do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey. Did you say you forgot to buy a carrot?

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… yeah. Our mom asked us to go shopping.

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… It's my fault! I was looking at candy and I forgot to help!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see… That's admirable of you to reflect on your mistake.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: As a reward… I'll let you have this carrot.

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Little Sister)
text_block_list.text: Hic… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters (Big Sister)
text_block_list.text: What?! A-are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. Here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You two get along well. …Watch out for cars on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega speaks softly as she hands the carrot to the two sisters who are still tightly holding hands.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well… That happens sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing you can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's her usual unfazed reaction, but I can tell that she's feeling more down than usual.
